It is `eq:ex-centered-sail` (`centered-construction.tex`) plus the treasury receipt, at radius `β̂_m^{-1/2} ≤ ϑ_m`, with `Z_A = Z_{N,p}` (`Accent.spiker` → `Accent.sail`, `Vac.suffices_bill`, `History.partition_eq`).

The source proves it eventually: `YM.Trace.Terrace.Meltdown`, from `supportQ` (support exponent ≥ 4 eventually) and the rate of `β̂`. The final statement should name it, together with `PostT.share` (`c_k ≤ log β̂_k`), `Scrim`, `Sceptre` and `Stock.Tabs`.
- Minor: N3 (the input is `fly ≤ 1`), N4 (`A_j` must be the lattice spacing `C.S.a`), N5 (interiority of `ug` from that of `g`).
